data_description.name: Name of the stove in Home Assistant.

thermostat.title: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Choose the temperature that drives the stove. Leave the sensor empty to use the stove probe (the stove regulates itself). Hysteresis, minimum times and notifications are set afterwards in *Configure*.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Any temperature sensor of Home Assistant, in the room to heat.
data_description.regulation_mode: On/off: Home Assistant turns the stove on and off around the target. Compensated: the stove stays on, its set point is shifted.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach hottoh_api at this address.

init.title: Thermostat
init.description: With no external sensor, the thermostat uses the stove probe and the stove regulates itself. With an external sensor, Home Assistant regulates: either by turning the stove on and off around the target (on/off), or by shifting the stove set point by the difference between both probes (compensated).

data.hysteresis_low: Turn on below the target by
data.hysteresis_high: Turn off above the target by
data.onoff_stove_setpoint: Stove set point in on/off mode
data.disable_chrono: Disable the chrono mode of the stove
data.sensor_timeout_minutes: Warn when the sensor is unavailable for

data_description.temperature_sensor: Leave empty to use the stove probe.
data_description.hysteresis_low: On/off mode: the stove is turned on at target minus this value.
data_description.hysteresis_high: On/off mode: the stove is turned off at target plus this value.
data_description.min_on_minutes: On/off mode: the stove is not turned off before this time (ignition takes about 15 min).
data_description.min_off_minutes: On/off mode: the stove is not turned on again before this time (shutdown takes about 40 min).
data_description.onoff_stove_setpoint: On/off mode: set point sent to the stove so that its own regulation does not stop it before Home Assistant does.
data_description.disable_chrono: The weekly schedule of the stove would fight the regulation of Home Assistant.
data_description.sensor_timeout_minutes: The regulation pauses while the sensor is unavailable; a notification is sent after this time.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Every event is also fired on the event bus as `hottoh_event`, for your automations.

data_description.notify_services: Legacy notify actions, such as notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.connection_lost_minutes: Delay before a lost stove link is notified (the module may reboot on its own in 5 min).

no_target.message: Choose a HottoH stove (device or entity) that is loaded.

set_power_level.name: Set power level
set_power_level.description: Sets the power level set point of the stove.

level.name: Level
level.description: From the minimum to the maximum power of the stove (often 1 to 10).

set_eco_mode.name: Set eco mode
set_eco_mode.description: Enables or disables the eco mode.

set_chrono_mode.name: Set chrono mode
set_chrono_mode.description: Enables or disables the weekly schedule of the stove.

set_fan_speed.name: Set fan speed
set_fan_speed.description: Sets the set point of a fan.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 0 to the maximum of the fan.

set_ambiance_temperature.name: Set stove set point
set_ambiance_temperature.description: Writes the room set point of the stove itself (not the target of an external regulation).

set_schedule.name: Set weekly schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the schedule of the given days (half-hour slots, program 0 to 3). Days left out keep their schedule.

days.name: Days
days.description: List of days, each with `day` (sunday to saturday) and `ranges` ({start, end, program}) or 48 `slots`.

sync_clock.name: Set the stove clock
sync_clock.description: Sets the module and stove clocks from the clock of the computer running hottoh_api.

restart_module.name: Restart the Wi-Fi module
restart_module.description: Restarts the Wi-Fi module of the stove (data unavailable for about 15 s).
